literature.headline_zh: 诺如病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期诺如病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 我们观察到 GI.3 变体之间的基因型内变异。GI.3喀麦隆/2017与其最接近的参考菌株(GI.3墨西哥/2016)具有相同的表型,并且它们的组织血型抗原(HBGA)结合谱表明与其他GI.3谱系相比,易感人群范围更窄。相反,GII.12 菌株在 HBGA 结合、抗原谱和组织附着方面没有显着差异。 [10.1128/jvi.01238-26]
七价 mRNA 疫苗 在小鼠和非洲绿猴中引发了强烈的体液反应,包括与 诺如病毒 病毒样颗粒 (VLP) 结合的血清 IgG 以及阻止 VLP 与组织血型抗原 (HBGA) 结合的功能性抗体。 [10.1128/jvi.01128-26]
即使在支持病毒强劲复制的条件下,HuNoV 感染也不会诱导成人或婴儿 HIO 分泌血清素。GII.4 HuNoV 复制在亲代 HIO 中很强,但在富含 EEC 的培养物中减少。来自亲本 HIO 的上清液未能刺激富含 EEC 的 HIO 释放血清素。 [10.1128/jvi.00833-26]
最近的研究结果表明,从儿科胃肠炎病例收集的临床粪便样本中,红球菌属与人类 诺如病毒 (NoV) 颗粒结合。 [10.3389/fmicb.2026.1987610]
所有氟化衍生物均表现出与天然 2'-FL 相当的结合亲和力,表明这些位置的氟化不会显着干扰配体识别。 [10.1021/acs.joc.6c02122]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: We observed intra-genotype variation among GI.3 variants. GI.3 Cameroon/2017 shared phenotypes with its closest reference strain (GI.3 Mexico/2016), and their histo-blood group antigen (HBGA)-binding profiles suggested a narrower susceptible population compared to other GI.3 lineages. [10.1128/jvi.01238-26]

The seven-valent mRNA vaccine elicited strong humoral responses in mice and African green monkeys, including serum IgG binding to norovirus virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs). [10.1128/jvi.01128-26]

HuNoV infection did not induce serotonin secretion in either adult or infant HIOs, even under conditions supporting robust viral replication. GII.4 HuNoV replication was robust in parental HIOs but reduced in EEC-enriched cultures. [10.1128/jvi.00833-26]
Recent findings have revealed that Rhodococcus species bind human norovirus (NoV) particles in clinical stool samples collected from pediatric gastroenteritis cases. [10.3389/fmicb.2026.1987610]

All fluorinated derivatives exhibited binding affinities comparable to native 2'-FL, indicating that fluorination at these positions does not significantly perturb ligand recognition. [10.1021/acs.joc.6c02122]

The seven-valent mRNA vaccine elicited strong humoral responses in mice and African green monkeys, including serum IgG binding to norovirus virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs). news.headline_zh: 诺如病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期诺如病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 过去五年中,诺如病毒 病例增加了一倍多,其中婴幼儿群体中的 暴发 病例显着增加。韩国疾病管理和预防机构 (KDCA) 报告了这一增长情况,并警告儿童保育设施中存在与该病毒相关的风险。 [news-312ec11b45f5b78a]
首尔卫生当局警告称,随着冬季临近,诺如病毒 感染病例可能会增加。首尔市政府正在为日托中心和幼儿园组织一次研讨会,讨论 传播、消毒和应对策略。该事件已根据官方声明得到证实。 [news-a861d72a75fb905f]
首尔特别市政府正在组织一个研讨会,以应对托儿所和幼儿园中的诺如病毒感染预防和管理,强调由于该病毒在冬季具有患病率特性及其对幼儿的影响,需要早期应对。 [news-ce5c8797927407c8]
罗克县卫生部门提供了有关 诺如病毒 相关设施关闭的指导,并报告了该县 诺如病毒 的状况。 [news-5b85c0fba937e617]
Cocrystal Pharma,Inc. 报告第三季度亏损扩大,原因是 诺如病毒 试验和管理活动支出增加。该公司于 2026 年 9 月完成了 1b 期 诺如病毒 挑战研究的给药,没有报告严重不良事件。 [news-8022f5a3cf238993]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Norovirus news developments.
key_findings_en: Norovirus cases have more than doubled over the past five years, with a significant rise in cluster outbreaks among infants and young children. The Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA) reported this increase and warned about the risks associated with the virus in childcare facilities. [news-312ec11b45f5b78a]

Health authorities in Seoul are warning of a potential rise in norovirus infections as winter approaches. papers.title: Characterization of norovirus GI.3 and GII.12 variants detected in wastewater: proof-of-concept for integrating phenotypic insights in wastewater-based epidemiology
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Norovirus is the leading cause of acute gastroenteritis, responsible for 685 million cases and 200,000 deaths annually. Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) enables not only global surveillance of dominant strains but also the detection of cryptic and emerging viral variants. An important question, however, is how to link genomic diversity to clinical impact and phenotypic traits of the strains detected in wastewater. In the Global Urban Wastewater Project, phylogenetically distinct norovirus GI.3 and GII.12 lineages were detected in wastewater from Cameroon. In this study, we characterized their host- and tissue-binding specificity and antigenic makeup in comparison with other GI.3 and GII.12 lineages using a luciferase immunoprecipitation system-based assay, alongside sequence analysis of the VP1 P2 subdomain. We observed intra-genotype variation among GI.3 variants. GI.3 Cameroon/2017 shared phenotypes with its closest reference strain (GI.3 Mexico/2016), and their histo-blood group antigen (HBGA)-binding profiles suggested a narrower susceptible population compared to other GI.3 lineages. Conversely, GII.12 strains showed no significant differences in HBGA binding, antigenic profiles, and tissue attachment. Together, these results reveal distinct patterns of phenotypic diversity between the two genotypes. While GI.3 variants exhibited lineage-specific traits, the GII.12 strains appeared phenotypically conserved across lineages. These findings highlight the feasibility and importance of integrating phenotypic analysis with WBE to assess potential public health risks posed by novel viral variants. IMPORTANCE While detection of norovirus through case-based surveillance is limited to variants causing symptomatic infection, wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) allows for detection of cryptic and emerging variants. However, validation, such as phenotypic characterization, is needed to assess the clinical importance of a variant detected in WBE. In this study, we investigated the phenotypic traits of genetically distinct GI.3 and GII.12 lineages detected in wastewater from Cameroon. We utilized NanoLuc luciferase immunoprecipitation system (N-LIPS)-based assays to assess binding specificity and antigenicity. Compared to traditional methods involving virus isolation and virus-like particle production, N-LIPS-based assays are considerably less laborious and faster. This allows for rapid characterization of novel variants, making the timely assessment of phenotypic changes of such variants for outbreak or pandemic preparedness feasible. Finally, by integrating insights from phenotypic assays, we showed the possibility of expanding the public health value of wastewater surveillance in assessing the risk of novel viral variants.

papers.title_zh: 废水中检测到的 诺如病毒 GI.3 和 GII.12 变体的表征:在基于废水的 流行病学 中整合表型见解的概念验证
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Norovirus is the leading cause of acute gastroenteritis, responsible for 685 million cases and 200,000 deaths annually. Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) enables not only global surveillance of dominant strains but also the detection of cryptic and emerging viral variants. An important question, however, is how to link genomic diversity to clinical impact and phenotypic traits of the strains detected in wastewater. In the Global Urban Wastewater Project, phylogenetically distinct norovirus GI.3 and GII.12 lineages were detected in wastewater from Cameroon. In this study, we characterized their host- and tissue-binding specificity and antigenic makeup in comparison with other GI.3 and GII.12 lineages using a luciferase immunoprecipitation system-based assay, alongside sequence analysis of the VP1 P2 subdomain. We observed intra-genotype variation among GI.3 variants. GI.3 Cameroon/2017 shared phenotypes with its closest reference strain (GI.3 Mexico/2016), and their histo-blood group antigen (HBGA)-binding profiles suggested a narrower susceptible population compared to other GI.3 lineages. Conversely, GII.12 strains showed no significant differences in HBGA binding, antigenic profiles, and tissue attachment. Together, these results reveal distinct patterns of phenotypic diversity between the two genotypes. While GI.3 variants exhibited lineage-specific traits, the GII.12 strains appeared phenotypically conserved across lineages. These findings highlight the feasibility and importance of integrating phenotypic analysis with WBE to assess potential public health risks posed by novel viral variants. IMPORTANCE While detection of norovirus through case-based surveillance is limited to variants causing symptomatic infection, wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) allows for detection of cryptic and emerging variants. However, validation, such as phenotypic characterization, is needed to assess the clinical importance of a variant detected in WBE. In this study, we investigated the phenotypic traits of genetically distinct GI.3 and GII.12 lineages detected in wastewater from Cameroon. We utilized NanoLuc luciferase immunoprecipitation system (N-LIPS)-based assays to assess binding specificity and antigenicity. Compared to traditional methods involving virus isolation and virus-like particle production, N-LIPS-based assays are considerably less laborious and faster. This allows for rapid characterization of novel variants, making the timely assessment of phenotypic changes of such variants for outbreak or pandemic preparedness feasible. Finally, by integrating insights from phenotypic assays, we showed the possibility of expanding the public health value of wastewater surveillance in assessing the risk of novel viral variants.

papers.title: A seven-valent norovirus mRNA vaccine elicits robust humoral responses in preclinical models
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Noroviruses are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis and impose a substantial global disease burden, particularly in children younger than 5 years and in older adults. Although multiple vaccine candidates are in preclinical and clinical development, no targeted intervention has been approved. We previously reported that a pentavalent mRNA vaccine candidate encoding VP1 proteins from genotypes GI.1, GII.2, GII.3, GII.4, and GII.6 elicited robust humoral and cellular immune responses in mice and nonhuman primates. Because recent surveillance data indicate increasing prevalence of GI.3 and GII.17, we designed mRNAs targeting these genotypes and evaluated an expanded seven-valent formulation in preclinical studies. We first compared candidate GI.3 and GII.17 strains in mice and selected vaccine components based on immunogenicity and cross-reactivity. The resulting seven-valent mRNA vaccine elicited strong humoral responses in mice and African green monkeys, including serum IgG binding to norovirus virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs). Importantly, incorporation of GI.3 and GII.17 broadened functional coverage, whereas multivalent formulation introduced only limited evidence of immune interference. These findings support the feasibility of surveillance-guided updating of multivalent norovirus mRNA vaccines and highlight the adaptability of the mRNA platform for addressing emerging variants. IMPORTANCE Norovirus is a major cause of vomiting and diarrhea worldwide, but developing a broadly protective vaccine is difficult because many genetically distinct strains circulate, and their prevalence changes over time. This study demonstrates a flexible vaccine strategy in which mRNA components can be selected and added based on disease surveillance and experimental evidence. We expanded a five-component norovirus vaccine to include GI.3 and GII.17, two increasingly important genotypes. The resulting seven-component vaccine generated strong antibody responses in mice and African green monkeys and broadened the range of virus types targeted by functional antibodies. Although additional studies are needed to determine whether these responses protect humans, the findings show how the adaptability of mRNA technology could support periodic updates of multivalent norovirus vaccines as circulating strains change.

papers.title_zh: 七价 诺如病毒 mRNA 疫苗 在临床前模型中引发强烈的体液反应
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Noroviruses are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis and impose a substantial global disease burden, particularly in children younger than 5 years and in older adults. Although multiple vaccine candidates are in preclinical and clinical development, no targeted intervention has been approved. We previously reported that a pentavalent mRNA vaccine candidate encoding VP1 proteins from genotypes GI.1, GII.2, GII.3, GII.4, and GII.6 elicited robust humoral and cellular immune responses in mice and nonhuman primates. Because recent surveillance data indicate increasing prevalence of GI.3 and GII.17, we designed mRNAs targeting these genotypes and evaluated an expanded seven-valent formulation in preclinical studies. We first compared candidate GI.3 and GII.17 strains in mice and selected vaccine components based on immunogenicity and cross-reactivity. The resulting seven-valent mRNA vaccine elicited strong humoral responses in mice and African green monkeys, including serum IgG binding to norovirus virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs). Importantly, incorporation of GI.3 and GII.17 broadened functional coverage, whereas multivalent formulation introduced only limited evidence of immune interference. These findings support the feasibility of surveillance-guided updating of multivalent norovirus mRNA vaccines and highlight the adaptability of the mRNA platform for addressing emerging variants. IMPORTANCE Norovirus is a major cause of vomiting and diarrhea worldwide, but developing a broadly protective vaccine is difficult because many genetically distinct strains circulate, and their prevalence changes over time. This study demonstrates a flexible vaccine strategy in which mRNA components can be selected and added based on disease surveillance and experimental evidence. We expanded a five-component norovirus vaccine to include GI.3 and GII.17, two increasingly important genotypes. The resulting seven-component vaccine generated strong antibody responses in mice and African green monkeys and broadened the range of virus types targeted by functional antibodies. Although additional studies are needed to determine whether these responses protect humans, the findings show how the adaptability of mRNA technology could support periodic updates of multivalent norovirus vaccines as circulating strains change.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 诺如病毒 是 急性胃肠炎 的主要原因,给全球带来了巨大的疾病负担,特别是对于 5 岁以下的儿童和老年人。尽管多个 疫苗 候选药物正处于临床前和临床开发阶段,但尚未批准有针对性的干预措施。我们之前报道过,编码来自基因型 GI.1、GII.2、GII.3、GII.4 和 GII.6 的 VP1 蛋白的五价 mRNA 疫苗 候选物在小鼠和非人灵长类动物中引发了强大的体液和细胞 免疫应答。由于最近的 监测 数据表明 GI.3 和 GII.17 的 患病率 有所增加,因此我们设计了针对这些基因型的 mRNA,并在临床前研究中评估了扩展的七价制剂。我们首先在小鼠中比较了候选 GI.3 和 GII.17 菌株,并根据免疫原性和交叉反应性选择了 疫苗 成分。由此产生的七价 mRNA 疫苗 在小鼠和非洲绿猴中引发了强烈的体液反应,包括与 诺如病毒 病毒样颗粒 (VLP) 结合的血清 IgG 以及阻止 VLP 与组织血型抗原 (HBGA) 结合的功能性抗体。重要的是,GI.3 和 GII.17 的合并扩大了功能覆盖范围,而多价制剂仅引入了有限的免疫干扰证据。这些发现支持 监测 引导的多价 诺如病毒 mRNA 疫苗 更新的可行性,并强调了 mRNA 平台解决新出现变异的适应性。重要性 诺如病毒 是全世界呕吐和腹泻的主要原因,但开发具有广泛保护性的 疫苗 很困难,因为许多遗传上不同的菌株在传播,并且它们的 患病率 会随着时间的推移而发生变化。这项研究展示了一种灵活的 疫苗 策略,其中可以根据疾病 监测 和实验证据选择和添加 mRNA 组件。我们扩展了五组分 诺如病毒 疫苗 以包括 GI.3 和 GII.17,这两个日益重要的基因型。由此产生的七组分 疫苗 在小鼠和非洲绿猴体内产生了强烈的抗体反应,并扩大了功能性抗体靶向的病毒类型范围。尽管还需要进行更多研究来确定这些反应是否可以保护人类,但研究结果表明 mRNA 技术的适应性如何支持多价 诺如病毒 疫苗 随着循环菌株的变化而定期更新。

papers.title: Synthesis of Fluorinated 2'-Fucosyllactose Analogues: Investigating the Roles of Primary and Anomeric Hydroxyl Groups in Norovirus Recognition.
papers.abstract: Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) inhibit norovirus attachment by acting as soluble decoy ligands. 2'-Fucosyllactose (2'-FL) is the most abundant component of HMOs and also one of the most studied, yet the contribution of individual hydroxyl groups in 2'-FL to molecular recognition remains unclear. To probe their roles, we synthesized a series of monofluorinated, difluorinated, and trifluoroethyl-substituted 2'-FL analogues bearing modifications at the primary and anomeric positions. The dissociation constants (Kd) of the fluorinated analogues toward the GII.4 Sydney norovirus P-domain were determined by chemical shift perturbation (CSP) NMR spectroscopy. All fluorinated derivatives exhibited binding affinities comparable to native 2'-FL, indicating that fluorination at these positions does not significantly perturb ligand recognition. These findings indicate that fluorination at the primary and anomeric positions of 2'-FL is well tolerated by the GII.4 Sydney norovirus P-domain, highlighting the utility of fluorinated 2'-FL analogues for probing carbohydrate-protein interactions.

papers.title_zh: 氟化 2'-岩藻糖基乳糖类似物的合成:研究伯羟基和异头羟基在 诺如病毒 识别中的作用。
papers.source_body_en: Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) inhibit norovirus attachment by acting as soluble decoy ligands. 2'-Fucosyllactose (2'-FL) is the most abundant component of HMOs and also one of the most studied, yet the contribution of individual hydroxyl groups in 2'-FL to molecular recognition remains unclear. To probe their roles, we synthesized a series of monofluorinated, difluorinated, and trifluoroethyl-substituted 2'-FL analogues bearing modifications at the primary and anomeric positions. The dissociation constants (Kd) of the fluorinated analogues toward the GII.4 Sydney norovirus P-domain were determined by chemical shift perturbation (CSP) NMR spectroscopy. All fluorinated derivatives exhibited binding affinities comparable to native 2'-FL, indicating that fluorination at these positions does not significantly perturb ligand recognition. These findings indicate that fluorination at the primary and anomeric positions of 2'-FL is well tolerated by the GII.4 Sydney norovirus P-domain, highlighting the utility of fluorinated 2'-FL analogues for probing carbohydrate-protein interactions.
papers.abstract_zh: 人乳寡糖 (HMO) 通过充当可溶性诱饵配体来抑制 诺如病毒 附着。2'-岩藻糖基乳糖 (2'-FL) 是 HMO 中最丰富的成分,也是研究最多的成分之一,但 2'-FL 中各个羟基对分子识别的贡献仍不清楚。为了探究它们的作用,我们合成了一系列在初级和异头位置带有修饰的单氟化、二氟化和三氟乙基取代的2'-FL类似物。通过化学位移微扰 (CSP) NMR 光谱测定氟化类似物对 GII.4 Sydney 诺如病毒 P 结构域的解离常数 (Kd)。所有氟化衍生物均表现出与天然 2'-FL 相当的结合亲和力,表明这些位置的氟化不会显着干扰配体识别。这些发现表明,GII.4 Sydney 诺如病毒 P 结构域能够很好地耐受 2'-FL 的初级和异头位置上的氟化,这凸显了氟化 2'-FL 类似物在探测碳水化合物-蛋白质相互作用方面的实用性。

papers.title: Human norovirus infection does not induce serotonin secretion in human intestinal organoids
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Human noroviruses (HuNoVs) are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide. The primary symptoms of HuNoV-associated disease are vomiting and diarrhea; yet the mechanisms underlying these symptoms are poorly understood. Neuroactive hormones such as serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine; 5-HT) secreted by intestinal enteroendocrine cells (EECs) can activate vomiting centers in the brain and play a critical role in regulating emetic signaling. Serotonin release from infected EECs has been implicated in vomiting during other enteric infections. Recent studies have reported the detection of HuNoV RNA and antigen in EECs in jejunal biopsies from immunocompromised patients with chronic HuNoV infection and rhesus macaques. We therefore investigated whether HuNoV infection of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) induces serotonin secretion. We examined infection and serotonin secretion with multiple genogroup II HuNoV strains using adult and infant jejunal HIO models, including a doxycycline-inducible neurogenin-3 HIO line with increased numbers of EECs. HuNoV infection did not induce serotonin secretion in either adult or infant HIOs as measured by ELISA. Consistent with enterocytes being the primary target cell type for HuNoVs, GII.4 HuNoV replication was robust in parental HIOs but reduced in EEC-enriched cultures. Furthermore, supernatants from parental HIOs failed to stimulate serotonin release from EEC-enriched HIOs. Together, these findings demonstrate that HuNoV infection of intestinal epithelial cells is insufficient to trigger serotonin release in HIOs. These results suggest that HuNoV-associated vomiting is unlikely to result from direct epithelial serotonin secretion and may require additional cellular components such as immune or neuronal signaling pathways or may involve other neuroactive hormones. IMPORTANCE Vomiting is a hallmark symptom of human norovirus disease. Yet, the biological mechanisms responsible for this response are unknown. Infection of enteroendocrine cells and secretion of serotonin play key roles in the emetic response to other gastrointestinal viruses such as rotavirus. Since recent studies have detected human norovirus antigens and RNA in enteroendocrine cells, we hypothesized that human norovirus infection could stimulate serotonin secretion. We used jejunal human intestinal organoids from adults and infants, including organoids enriched for enteroendocrine cells, and found that infection with several clinically important strains did not induce serotonin secretion, even under conditions supporting robust viral replication. These data indicate that serotonin release from intestinal epithelial cells alone is unlikely to explain norovirus-induced vomiting and highlights the need to investigate alternative mechanisms, including other neuroactive hormones, and neuronal signaling pathways to better understand the pathogenesis of norovirus-associated vomiting.

papers.title: Rhodococcus–norovirus interactions: a hypothesis of affinity-driven viral release from bacterial exopolysaccharides
papers.abstract: Recent findings have revealed that Rhodococcus species bind human norovirus (NoV) particles in clinical stool samples collected from pediatric gastroenteritis cases. This recurring association across independent samples suggests a potentially relevant biological interaction. The binding appears to be mediated by exopolysaccharides (EPSs), which are typically rich in fucose, galactose, and glucuronic acid residues and may structurally mimic histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs), the known cellular receptors for NoV. We propose that these EPSs may function as transient viral carriers capable of stabilizing virions while maintaining reversible interactions with the viral capsid. We further hypothesize an affinity-driven release mechanism, whereby authentic HBGAs on host epithelial cells, possessing higher binding affinity, displace virions from bacterial EPSs, thereby facilitating timely infection. This interaction may serve a dual function: Environmental stabilization of the virus and its controlled release upon encountering host cells. If validated, this model would support the concept that bacterial glycans act as dynamic, reversible docking platforms that influence NoV ecology, transmission, and infectivity.

papers.abstract_zh: 最近的研究结果表明,从儿科胃肠炎病例收集的临床粪便样本中,红球菌属与人类 诺如病毒 (NoV) 颗粒结合。独立样本之间的这种反复出现的关联表明存在潜在相关的生物相互作用。这种结合似乎是由胞外多糖(EPS)介导的,胞外多糖通常富含岩藻糖、半乳糖和葡萄糖醛酸残基,并且可能在结构上模仿组织血型抗原(HBGA),即NoV的已知细胞受体。我们认为这些 EPS 可能作为瞬时病毒载体,能够稳定病毒粒子,同时保持与病毒衣壳的可逆相互作用。我们进一步假设了一种亲和力驱动的释放机制,即 宿主 上皮细胞上的真实 HBGA 具有更高的结合亲和力,可以取代细菌 EPS 中的病毒颗粒,从而促进及时感染。这种相互作用可能具有双重功能:病毒的环境稳定及其在遇到 宿主 细胞时的受控释放。如果得到验证,该模型将支持细菌聚糖作为影响 NoV 生态、传播 和感染性的动态、可逆对接平台的概念。

papers.title: Near-complete genome sequences of five norovirus GII.4[P31] strains from coastal Kenya, 2019
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT There is limited norovirus genomic data from Africa. We report five near-complete norovirus genomes of genotype GII.4[P31], recovered from stool samples of children admitted with acute diarrhea in coastal Kenya during 2019. These expand the available genomic data resource for norovirus evolutionary studies, molecular assay improvement, and therapeutics development.

The research aimed to address the limited genomic data available for norovirus in Africa, which is crucial for understanding its genetic diversity and evolution. The methods involved sequencing viral genomes from stool samples, which expanded the genomic data resource for norovirus evolutionary studies, molecular assay improvement, and therapeutics development. The main results included the successful recovery of five near-complete genomes, contributing to the genetic database of norovirus in the region. The findings highlight the importance of these sequences for improving surveillance and diagnostic tools in African populations. The study's limitations include its focus on a single region and genotype, but the evidence is strong due to the direct genomic data obtained. The results have significant implications for public health, particularly in the context of norovirus gastroenteritis, and provide a foundation for future research on the virus in Africa.

papers.title: Single-cell profiling of the duodenum during chronic human norovirus infection
papers.abstract: Human noroviruses are a major cause of diarrheal disease, yet their pathogenesis remains poorly defined. We performed single-cell RNA sequencing of duodenal biopsies and matched stem cell–derived enteroids from immunodeficient individuals with chronic norovirus infection. Norovirus RNA was detected primarily in enterocytes, enteroendocrine cells, and macrophages, with the highest proportion of viral RNA-positive cells observed among M2 macrophages, followed by late enterocytes. Despite this distribution, late enterocytes produced higher viral yields than differentiated M2 macrophages in vitro. Norovirus infection was associated with the up-regulation of MHC class I-related genes and IL15 in duodenal macrophages and late enterocytes, together with increased IFNG expression by CD8 T cells. Macrophages and late enterocytes up-regulated CXCL9 and CXCL10/11 , respectively, consistent with CD8 and CD4 T cell recruitment to the duodenum. These findings show that noroviruses infect and persist across multiple permissive cell types during chronic infection, resulting in marked dysregulation of innate and adaptive immune responses that may drive pathogenesis.

papers.title: Integrated molecular and epidemiological assessment of pediatric viral gastroenteritis using qRT-PCR versus rapid immunochromatographic diagnostics
papers.abstract: Background: Viral gastroenteritis represents a major cause of pediatric morbidity, being one of the leading acute conditions requiring emergency care or hospitalization. Enteric viruses such as rotavirus, norovirus, adenovirus, astrovirus, and sapovirus are frequently implicated, with prevalence varying by age and season. The objective of this study was to assess the distribution of viral agents in children and to compare the performance of two diagnostic methods: immunochromatographic (ICT) and quantitative real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Materials and methods: In a retrospective study, a total of 164 children hospitalized with acute gastroenteritis between February 2023 and March 2025 were investigated using qRT-PCR and ICT methods. Results: The positivity rate for rotavirus, norovirus and adenovirus was 58.5% by qRT-PCR compared to 25.0% by ICT, with slightly higher rates in urban areas (62/103) and in females (54/73). The most affected age group was 1-3 years, with increased incidence during warm seasons. rotavirus was the predominant pathogen (66 cases by qRT-PCR; 32 by ICT), followed by norovirus (41 cases vs. 11), while viral co-infections accounted for 11% of cases. These findings highlight the importance of rapid and accurate etiological diagnosis for appropriate management, prevention of complications, and reduction of unnecessary antibiotic use. Conclusions: Our findings demonstrated a higher diagnostic performance of qRT-PCR compared with ICT, particularly for the detection of norovirus and rotavirus. Although rapid ICT tests may serve as an initial diagnostic tool in settings with limited access to molecular testing, qRT-PCR provides more reliable pathogen detection and may improve the accuracy of etiological diagnosis. However, the clinical impact of molecular testing on treatment decisions, antibiotic prescriptions, hospitalization duration, and patient outcomes was not assessed in this study.

source_records.title: Integrated molecular and epidemiological assessment of pediatric viral gastroenteritis using qRT-PCR versus rapid immunochromatographic diagnostics
source_records.abstract: Background: Viral gastroenteritis represents a major cause of pediatric morbidity, being one of the leading acute conditions requiring emergency care or hospitalization. Enteric viruses such as rotavirus, norovirus, adenovirus, astrovirus, and sapovirus are frequently implicated, with prevalence varying by age and season. The objective of this study was to assess the distribution of viral agents in children and to compare the performance of two diagnostic methods: immunochromatographic (ICT) and quantitative real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Materials and methods: In a retrospective study, a total of 164 children hospitalized with acute gastroenteritis between February 2023 and March 2025 were investigated using qRT-PCR and ICT methods. Results: The positivity rate for rotavirus, norovirus and adenovirus was 58.5% by qRT-PCR compared to 25.0% by ICT, with slightly higher rates in urban areas (62/103) and in females (54/73). The most affected age group was 1-3 years, with increased incidence during warm seasons. rotavirus was the predominant pathogen (66 cases by qRT-PCR; 32 by ICT), followed by norovirus (41 cases vs. 11), while viral co-infections accounted for 11% of cases. These findings highlight the importance of rapid and accurate etiological diagnosis for appropriate management, prevention of complications, and reduction of unnecessary antibiotic use. Conclusions: Our findings demonstrated a higher diagnostic performance of qRT-PCR compared with ICT, particularly for the detection of norovirus and rotavirus. Although rapid ICT tests may serve as an initial diagnostic tool in settings with limited access to molecular testing, qRT-PCR provides more reliable pathogen detection and may improve the accuracy of etiological diagnosis. However, the clinical impact of molecular testing on treatment decisions, antibiotic prescriptions, hospitalization duration, and patient outcomes was not assessed in this study.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 病毒性胃肠炎是儿科发病的主要原因,是需要紧急护理或住院治疗的主要急性病症之一。轮状病毒、诺如病毒、腺病毒、星状病毒和沙波病毒等肠道病毒经常受到影响,患病率 因年龄和季节而异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究的目的是评估儿童中病毒因子的分布,并比较两种诊断方法的性能:免疫层析(ICT)和定量实时逆转录聚合酶链反应(qRT-PCR)。在一项回顾性研究中,使用 qRT-PCR 和 ICT 方法对 2023 年 2 月至 2025 年 3 月期间因 急性胃肠炎 住院的 164 名儿童进行了调查。
elements_zh.methods: 轮状病毒是主要病原体(qRT-PCR 检测 66 例;ICT 检测 32 例),其次是 诺如病毒(41 例 vs. 11 例),病毒合并感染占病例的 11%。尽管快速 ICT 检测可作为分子检测机会有限的环境中的初始诊断工具,但 qRT-PCR 提供更可靠的病原体检测,并可提高病原学 诊断 的准确性。
elements_zh.main_results: qRT-PCR 检测的轮状病毒、诺如病毒 和腺病毒的阳性率为 58.5%,而 ICT 检测的阳性率为 25.0%,城市地区 (62/103) 和女性 (54/73) 的阳性率略高。受影响最严重的年龄组是 1-3 岁,在温暖季节 发病率 增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究结果表明,与 ICT 相比,qRT-PCR 具有更高的诊断性能,特别是在 诺如病毒 和轮状病毒的检测方面。这些发现强调了快速、准确的病因学 诊断 对于适当管理、预防并发症和减少不必要的抗生素使用的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究为 qRT-PCR 对 诺如病毒 和轮状病毒在儿科胃肠炎中的诊断准确性提供了重要见解,这可以为临床环境中改进的 监测 和诊断策略提供参考。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究未评估分子检测对 治疗 决策、抗生素处方、住院时间和患者结果的临床影响。由于该研究是回顾性的并且不评估临床结果,因此证据是中等的。

analysis_zh.main_results: qRT-PCR 检测的轮状病毒、诺如病毒 和腺病毒的阳性率为 58.5%,而 ICT 检测的阳性率为 25.0%,城市地区 (62/103) 和女性 (54/73) 的阳性率略高。受影响最严重的年龄组是 1-3 岁,在温暖季节 发病率 增加。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 我们的研究结果表明,与 ICT 相比,qRT-PCR 具有更高的诊断性能,特别是在 诺如病毒 和轮状病毒的检测方面。这些发现强调了快速、准确的病因学 诊断 对于适当管理、预防并发症和减少不必要的抗生素使用的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究为 qRT-PCR 对 诺如病毒 和轮状病毒在儿科胃肠炎中的诊断准确性提供了重要见解,这可以为临床环境中改进的 监测 和诊断策略提供参考。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究未评估分子检测对 治疗 决策、抗生素处方、住院时间和患者结果的临床影响。由于该研究是回顾性的并且不评估临床结果,因此证据是中等的。

papers.title: Impact to Healthcare-Associated Viral Gastroenteritis Infection Rate Using Different Visitation Models in a Pediatric Hospital.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Pediatric healthcare-associated viral gastroenteritis infections (HA-VGI) contribute to morbidity, prolonged hospitalization, and outbreaks. Visitor-related transmission is a recognized risk factor; associations between visitation models and HA-VGI incidence remain understudied. METHODS: HA-VGI rates were compared across four visitation models: (Period 1) seasonal visitation, visitors <13 years restricted December 1-April 30; (Period 2) two legally authorized representatives (LAR) permitted, mandatory masking; (Period 3) masking with an LAR-approved 10-person visitor list, including siblings; (Period 4) identical visitation model without masking (December 2017-June 2025). HA-VGI was defined as gastroenteritis on or after hospital day 3. Changepoint analysis, interrupted time series modeling, nonparametric comparisons, and multivariable linear regression assessed differences across periods. Regression models adjusted for community GI viral activity and calendar month. Rates were compared by unit and pathogen. RESULTS: Median HA-VGI rates declined significantly during Period 2 compared with Period 1 (0.93 vs. 5.14 per 10,000 patient days; p<0.001). Although rates increased in Period 3, they remained below Period 1. Adjusted regression demonstrated lower rates during Periods 2 and 3 than during Period 1 (β=-3.01 and -3.07, respectively; both p<0.001). Period 4 did not significantly differ from Period 1. Community GI viral activity was independently associated with HA-VGI rates (β=5.94; p=0.002). ICU rates were lower than non-ICU rates; norovirus predominated. CONCLUSIONS: Year-round sibling visitation with visitor limits was not associated with increased HA-VGI incidence compared to seasonal visitation. Mandatory masking was associated with lower HA-VGI rates independent of community viral activity and seasonality and may provide protection during increased GI viral circulation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of different visitation models on healthcare-associated viral gastroenteritis (HA-VGI) infection rates in a pediatric hospital. It compares HA-VGI rates across four periods with varying visitation policies, including seasonal restrictions, mandatory masking, and sibling visitation. The results show a significant decline in HA-VGI rates during Period 2 with mandatory masking, and rates in Period 3 remained lower than Period 1 despite increased sibling visitation. Community GI viral activity was independently linked to HA-VGI rates, and norovirus was predominant. The authors conclude that mandatory masking may reduce HA-VGI rates independently of seasonality and community viral activity, suggesting a potential public health strategy. However, the study's observational design limits its ability to establish causality, and the evidence strength is moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 儿科医疗相关病毒性胃肠炎感染 (HA-VGI) 会导致发病、住院时间延长和 暴发。与访客相关的 传播 是公认的风险因素;访问模型和 HA-VGI 发病率 之间的关联仍未得到充分研究。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 比较了四种访问模式的 HA-VGI 率:(第 1 期)季节性访问,13 岁以下的访问者限制在 12 月 1 日至 4 月 30 日;(第 2 阶段)两名合法授权代表 (LAR) 允许,强制屏蔽;(第 3 阶段)使用 LAR 批准的 10 人访客名单进行掩饰,其中包括兄弟姐妹;(第 4 期)无掩蔽的相同访问模型(2017 年 12 月至 2025 年 6 月)。
elements_zh.methods: HA-VGI 被定义为住院第 3 天或之后的胃肠炎。变化点分析、中断时间序列建模、非参数比较和多变量线性回归评估了不同时期的差异。根据社区胃肠道病毒活动和日历月份调整回归模型。按单位和病原体比较比率。
elements_zh.main_results: 与第 1 阶段相比,第 2 阶段的中位 HA-VGI 率显着下降(每 10,000 患者日 0.93 对比 5.14;p<0.001)。尽管第 3 阶段的比率有所增加,但仍低于第 1 阶段。第 4 阶段与第 1 阶段没有显着差异。社区 GI 病毒活动与 HA-VGI 比率独立相关(β=5.94;p=0.002)。ICU 比率低于非 ICU 比率;诺如病毒 占主导地位。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 调整后的回归显示,第 2 期和第 3 期的比率低于第 1 期的比率(β 分别=-3.01 和 -3.07;均 p<0.001)。强制掩蔽与较低的 HA-VGI 率相关,与社区病毒活动和季节性无关,并且可以在胃肠道病毒循环增加期间提供保护。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,探视期间强制佩戴口罩可能会降低 HA-VGI 率,为减轻儿科医院病毒 传播 的影响提供了潜在的公共卫生策略。这些结果可能会为医院关于访客限制和感染控制措施的政策提供依据。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于观察数据,并未建立因果关系。由于缺乏随机对照试验且未充分考虑潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Acute diarrhea following the first subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab: a case report of a probable adverse drug reaction
papers.abstract: Background Tafolecimab is a fully human monoclonal antibody targeting proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9). Diarrhea is a recognized adverse reaction, but detailed post-marketing case descriptions with clear timing, differential assessment, and outcome remain limited. Case Summary A 51-year-old man hospitalized for non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction received his first one-time 600-mg subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab (SINTBILO) at 15:14 on 13 July 2026. Approximately 7 h 46 min later, he developed abdominal pain and diarrhea occurring 5–8 times daily, with nausea and mild periumbilical pain but no fever, tenesmus, visible hematochezia or melena, dehydration, hypotension, rebound tenderness, or guarding. Stool testing showed loose yellow stool, positive occult blood and red blood cells, 0–1 white blood cells/high-power field, and a negative rotavirus test; electrolytes and liver and kidney function were normal. Stool culture and testing for Clostridioides difficile, norovirus, and adenovirus were not performed. Tafolecimab was not re-administered. After fluid replacement, montmorillonite, and loperamide hydrochloride, diarrhea decreased within 1 day and resolved after approximately 2 days, with no recurrence after discharge. Long-term stable acarbose therapy was continued without recurrence. The Naranjo score was 5, indicating a probable adverse drug reaction. Conclusion This case supports probable tafolecimab-associated acute diarrhea. New-onset diarrhea after PCSK9 inhibitor initiation should prompt precise temporal documentation, medication reconciliation, targeted microbiological evaluation, and pharmacovigilance reporting.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to report a case of acute diarrhea following the first subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab, highlighting the need for further investigation into potential adverse drug reactions associated with this PCSK9 inhibitor.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case report was conducted on a 51-year-old man hospitalized for non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction who received his first 600-mg subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab on 13 July 2026.
analysis.methods: The patient's symptoms were documented, and stool testing was performed to assess for pathogens, including occult blood, red blood cells, and specific viral markers, while excluding tests for rotavirus, Clostridioides difficile, norovirus, and adenovirus.
analysis.main_results: The patient developed acute diarrhea 7 h 46 min after receiving tafolecimab, characterized by 5–8 episodes daily, with loose yellow stool, positive occult blood, and red blood cells, but no white blood cells, and a negative rotavirus test. Diarrhea resolved within 2 days after treatment with fluids, montmorillonite, and loperamide hydrochloride.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case suggests a probable adverse drug reaction to tafolecimab, as supported by the Naranjo score of 5, and highlights the importance of monitoring for new-onset diarrhea following PCSK9 inhibitor initiation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for precise temporal documentation, medication reconciliation, targeted microbiological evaluation, and pharmacovigilance reporting in cases of new-onset diarrhea after PCSK9 inhibitor use.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable. However, the Naranjo score of 5 provides a moderate level of confidence in the probable adverse drug reaction.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old man who developed acute diarrhea following his first subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab, a PCSK9 inhibitor, on 13 July 2026. The patient experienced 5–8 episodes of diarrhea daily, with loose yellow stool, positive occult blood, and red blood cells, but no white blood cells or rotavirus. Diarrhea resolved within 2 days after treatment with fluids, montmorillonite, and loperamide hydrochloride. The Naranjo score of 5 indicated a probable adverse drug reaction. The case underscores the importance of monitoring for new-onset diarrhea after PCSK9 inhibitor initiation and highlights the need for targeted microbiological evaluation and pharmacovigilance reporting. While the study is limited to a single case, the findings contribute to understanding potential adverse effects of tafolecimab.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to report a case of acute diarrhea following the first subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab, highlighting the need for further investigation into potential adverse drug reactions associated with this PCSK9 inhibitor.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: A case report was conducted on a 51-year-old man hospitalized for non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction who received his first 600-mg subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab on 13 July 2026.
analysis_en.methods: The patient's symptoms were documented, and stool testing was performed to assess for pathogens, including occult blood, red blood cells, and specific viral markers, while excluding tests for rotavirus, Clostridioides difficile, norovirus, and adenovirus.
analysis_en.main_results: The patient developed acute diarrhea 7 h 46 min after receiving tafolecimab, characterized by 5–8 episodes daily, with loose yellow stool, positive occult blood, and red blood cells, but no white blood cells, and a negative rotavirus test. Diarrhea resolved within 2 days after treatment with fluids, montmorillonite, and loperamide hydrochloride.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The case suggests a probable adverse drug reaction to tafolecimab, as supported by the Naranjo score of 5, and highlights the importance of monitoring for new-onset diarrhea following PCSK9 inhibitor initiation.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for precise temporal documentation, medication reconciliation, targeted microbiological evaluation, and pharmacovigilance reporting in cases of new-onset diarrhea after PCSK9 inhibitor use.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable. However, the Naranjo score of 5 provides a moderate level of confidence in the probable adverse drug reaction.

papers.title_zh: 首次皮下注射他福昔单抗后出现急性腹泻:可能的药物不良反应的 病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Background Tafolecimab is a fully human monoclonal antibody targeting proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9). Diarrhea is a recognized adverse reaction, but detailed post-marketing case descriptions with clear timing, differential assessment, and outcome remain limited. Case Summary A 51-year-old man hospitalized for non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction received his first one-time 600-mg subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab (SINTBILO) at 15:14 on 13 July 2026. Approximately 7 h 46 min later, he developed abdominal pain and diarrhea occurring 5–8 times daily, with nausea and mild periumbilical pain but no fever, tenesmus, visible hematochezia or melena, dehydration, hypotension, rebound tenderness, or guarding. Stool testing showed loose yellow stool, positive occult blood and red blood cells, 0–1 white blood cells/high-power field, and a negative rotavirus test; electrolytes and liver and kidney function were normal. Stool culture and testing for Clostridioides difficile, norovirus, and adenovirus were not performed. Tafolecimab was not re-administered. After fluid replacement, montmorillonite, and loperamide hydrochloride, diarrhea decreased within 1 day and resolved after approximately 2 days, with no recurrence after discharge. Long-term stable acarbose therapy was continued without recurrence. The Naranjo score was 5, indicating a probable adverse drug reaction. Conclusion This case supports probable tafolecimab-associated acute diarrhea. New-onset diarrhea after PCSK9 inhibitor initiation should prompt precise temporal documentation, medication reconciliation, targeted microbiological evaluation, and pharmacovigilance reporting.

papers.title: Yield of a multiplexed gastrointestinal polymerase chain reaction panel for evaluation of diarrhea in hospitalized patients with cancer: a diagnostic stewardship opportunity
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Multiplexed polymerase chain reaction gastrointestinal panels (GIPs) include mostly community-acquired pathogens. Diagnostic yield of GIPs for detection of non- Clostridioides difficile targets in hospitalized patients with cancer with community versus hospital-onset diarrhea is not well defined. Methods: This cross-sectional study included stool tests from hospitalized adults with a cancer diagnosis from July 2021 to May 2025. Our center recommends a GIP primarily for patients with community-onset diarrhea and stand-alone C. difficile testing for hospital-onset diarrhea. Generalized estimating equations with Poisson regression were used to estimate the prevalence ratio (PR) of detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target after hospital day (HD) 3 compared to HD 1–3. Results: Among 1,433 GIPs from 1,127 patients, 468 (33%) were ordered after HD 3. Most GIPs were among patients with hematologic malignancies (794/1,433; 55%) and of those tests 352/794 (44%) were ordered after HD 3. difficile and norovirus were detected most frequently (16% and 6%, respectively). difficile target was detected after HD 3 on 49/468 GIPs (10%), compared to 146/965 (15%) GIPs on HD 1–3 (adjusted PR 0.73; 95% CI [0.53–1.00]; P = .053). Among 49 GIPs after HD 3 detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target, 19 tests were ordered for new-onset diarrhea and only 5 of these patients received intentional antimicrobial therapy in response to the GIP result. Conclusions: The added diagnostic yield for detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target by GIP in patients with cancer and hospital-onset diarrhea is limited and supports restricting GIP ordering after HD 3 on oncology units.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the diagnostic yield of multiplexed gastrointestinal polymerase chain reaction (GIP) panels for detecting non-Clostridioides difficile pathogens in hospitalized cancer patients with diarrhea. It found that GIPs were less effective in identifying such pathogens after hospital day 3 compared to earlier days, with C. difficile and norovirus being the most frequently detected. The results suggest that the added value of GIPs in this context is limited, supporting the restriction of GIP testing after HD 3 on oncology units. The study's cross-sectional design and reliance on observational data result in moderate confidence in its findings, highlighting the need for further research to confirm these results and their implications for diagnostic stewardship in cancer patients with hospital-onset diarrhea.

papers.title_zh: 用于评估住院癌症患者腹泻的多重胃肠道聚合酶链反应小组的产量:诊断管理机会
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background: Multiplexed polymerase chain reaction gastrointestinal panels (GIPs) include mostly community-acquired pathogens. Diagnostic yield of GIPs for detection of non- Clostridioides difficile targets in hospitalized patients with cancer with community versus hospital-onset diarrhea is not well defined. Methods: This cross-sectional study included stool tests from hospitalized adults with a cancer diagnosis from July 2021 to May 2025. Our center recommends a GIP primarily for patients with community-onset diarrhea and stand-alone C. difficile testing for hospital-onset diarrhea. Generalized estimating equations with Poisson regression were used to estimate the prevalence ratio (PR) of detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target after hospital day (HD) 3 compared to HD 1–3. Results: Among 1,433 GIPs from 1,127 patients, 468 (33%) were ordered after HD 3. Most GIPs were among patients with hematologic malignancies (794/1,433; 55%) and of those tests 352/794 (44%) were ordered after HD 3. difficile and norovirus were detected most frequently (16% and 6%, respectively). difficile target was detected after HD 3 on 49/468 GIPs (10%), compared to 146/965 (15%) GIPs on HD 1–3 (adjusted PR 0.73; 95% CI [0.53–1.00]; P = .053). Among 49 GIPs after HD 3 detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target, 19 tests were ordered for new-onset diarrhea and only 5 of these patients received intentional antimicrobial therapy in response to the GIP result. Conclusions: The added diagnostic yield for detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target by GIP in patients with cancer and hospital-onset diarrhea is limited and supports restricting GIP ordering after HD 3 on oncology units.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景:多重聚合酶链反应胃肠道检测组合(GIP)主要包括社区获得性病原体。GIP 在社区癌症住院患者与院内腹泻患者中检测非艰难梭菌靶标的诊断率尚未明确。方法:这项横断面研究包括 2021 年 7 月至 2025 年 5 月住院的癌症 诊断 成人的粪便检测。我们中心建议主要对社区发病的腹泻患者进行 GIP,并对医院发病的腹泻进行独立的艰难梭菌检测。使用泊松回归的广义估计方程来估计与 HD 1-3 相比,在住院第 3 天 (HD) 后检测到 ≥1 个非艰难梭菌目标的 患病率 比率 (PR)。结果:在 1,127 名患者的 1,433 项 GIP 中,有 468 项 (33%) 在 HD 3 后进行。大多数 GIP 是在血液系统恶性肿瘤患者中进行的 (794/1,433;55%),其中 352/794 (44%) 在 HD 3 后进行。艰难梭菌和 诺如病毒 的检测频率最高(16% 和 6%,分别)。HD 3 后,49/468 个 GIP (10%) 检测到艰难梭菌靶标,而 HD 1-3 上检测到 146/965 (15%) GIP(调整后 PR 0.73;95% CI [0.53-1.00];P = .053)。在 HD 3 后检测到 ≥1 个非艰难梭菌目标的 49 名 GIP 中,有 19 名患者被安排进行新发腹泻检测,其中只有 5 名患者根据 GIP 结果接受了有意的抗菌治疗。结论:在癌症和院内腹泻患者中,通过 GIP 检测 ≥1 个非艰难梭菌目标的额外诊断率有限,并且支持在肿瘤科单位的 HD 3 后限制 GIP 排序。

Research support: GSK, Novartis, Janssen, Genentech/Roche. Patents/royalties: Novartis. All other authors declare no conflicts of interest. Funding: The authors have nothing to report. Acknowledgments: None Authors' Contributions: RF: data collection, data analysis, manuscript writing. XJB: myeloid disease assessment, manuscript review. SPSA, ALG, ADC, SK, CEL, SML, EAS, DTV, AW: clinical care of patients, manuscript review. SPSA: study conception, supervision, manuscript review. Data Availability Statement: The data that support the findings of this study are not publicly available due to patient privacy and confidentiality restrictions but are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. The authors declare no use of generative AI or AI-assisted tools in this manuscript. Longer survival and cumulative treatment exposure in multiple myeloma (MM) have increased the clinical relevance of coexisting myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML), including therapy-related myeloid neoplasms. Prior cytotoxic therapy and selection of susceptible clones during lenalidomide exposure contribute to this risk.1˒2 These dual diagnoses create intersecting treatment constraints: impaired hematopoiesis can limit MM therapy, myeloid-directed treatment can compound cytopenias and infection risk, and persistent cytopenias may reflect either malignancy or treatment toxicity. B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA)-targeted therapies, like teclistamab, have shown high efficacy in RRMM across pivotal clinical trials, including MajesTec-1, -3, and -9.3,4,5 However, these clinical trials excluded patients with MDS and other active malignancies, leaving limited evidence for this population. We describe six selected teclistamab recipients with MM and MDS/AML diagnosed before or after treatment initiation, focusing on treatment delivery, MM response, and myeloid disease course. We retrospectively reviewed patients treated at the University of Pennsylvania, between January 1, 2023, and December 31, 2025, who had: (1) RRMM requiring therapy, (2) a diagnosis of MDS or AML, and (3) receipt of at least one dose of teclistamab. Clinical data were abstracted from the electronic medical record, including demographics, prior MM therapies, cytogenetic and molecular features of MM and MDS/AML, laboratory parameters at teclistamab initiation, infectious complications, transfusion requirements, and treatment responses. Myeloma responses were assessed per IMWG criteria. Myeloid disease risk was categorized according to IPSS-M when applicable.6 This study was deemed exempt and patient consent was waived by the University of Pennsylvania Institutional Review. Six male patients (aged 70-86 years) met criteria. Median prior lines of therapy was 6.5. Four were penta-class exposed and two were triple-class exposed. Patients 1 and 2 had previously received idecabtagene vicleucel. Three patients were diagnosed with MDS/AML before initiating teclistamab, while the remaining were diagnosed after therapy initiation. The interval from MM diagnosis to MDS/AML diagnosis varied, with a median of 46.8 months (range 0–132.8 months). Four patients had very low or low IPSS-M risk disease, and one had moderately high-risk features. Patient 3, who was treated as AML, was classified as adverse risk per European LeukemiaNet (ELN) 2022/2024 less-intensive criteria.7,8 Median follow-up from teclistamab initiation was 24.0 months (range 10.8–38.8 months). Cytopenias were common, and patients 1–3 required temporary teclistamab holds for worsening counts. Management of MDS/AML included observation or supportive care, azacitidine for patient 1, azacitidine plus venetoclax for patient 3, and luspatercept for patient 6 (Table 1). All patients received antiviral, Pneumocystis prophylaxis, and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) to maintain IgG levels > 400 mg/dL. Documented infections included recurrent pneumonia, rhinovirus/enterovirus, COVID-19 and chronic norovirus-associated diarrhea (Table 2). All patients achieved at least a very good partial response (VGPR) or better during initial teclistamab course; patient 3 also received palliative radiation. Five stopped treatment after a median of 9.6 months (range 6.5-18.1 months): two enrolled in a limited-duration teclistamab trial (NCT05932680)9, two due to cytopenias requiring transfusions, and one because of recurrent infections. Patient 6 continued teclistamab with a complete response (CR). Patients 1, 3 and 4 restarted teclistamab after MM progression. CR was reported after retreatment in patients 1 and 3, whereas patient 4 progressed three months after restarting. Patient 2 died from progressive MM after switching therapy. Five of six patients demonstrated stable MDS throughout the period of teclistamab exposure. Patient 1 developed high-risk MDS approximately 11 months after teclistamab initiation and progressed to AML approximately 15 months later. No other myeloid progression was reported. In this single-center series, teclistamab produced deep MM responses in six selected patients with MDS or AML diagnosed before or after treatment initiation. These dual diagnoses create competing therapeutic demands: controlling MM while preserving limited hematopoietic reserve and managing a second marrow malignancy. Cytopenias and infections constrained treatment delivery despite MM responses, illustrating that disease control and treatment tolerance must be assessed separately. Selection bias is the principal limitation of these observations. Patients with rapidly progressive MDS/AML, those requiring urgent induction chemotherapy or allogeneic transplantation, and those dying before a subsequent MM relapse would be unlikely to receive teclistamab. This series therefore preferentially captures patients who survived and remained suitable for MM- directed therapy; four of the five patients with MDS had very low or low IPSS-M risk. Moreover, three myeloid diagnoses were established after teclistamab initiation. Their earlier exposure cannot demonstrate feasibility in patients with known active MDS/AML at treatment initiation. The findings should therefore be interpreted as a descriptive experience in selected patients rather than evidence of safety across the broader population with dual diagnoses. The mechanisms underlying cytopenias in this setting are likely multifactorial, including impaired hematopoiesis from either malignancy, cumulative treatment exposure, concurrent myeloid-directed therapy, and treatment-associated inflammation. Clonal hematopoiesis and inflammatory signaling have been associated with hematologic toxicity and secondary myeloid neoplasms after BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy,10˒11 but their contribution during bispecific-antibody treatment remains uncertain. Without systematic pretreatment marrow assessment and myeloid sequencing, we cannot determine whether diagnoses made after teclistamab reflected previously unrecognized disease or subsequent clonal evolution. Although uniform myeloid progression was not observed, the heterogeneous trajectories do not establish that teclistamab leaves myeloid disease biology unaffected. Similarly, patient 1’s progression from MDS to AML cannot be compared with the natural history of MDS without an appropriate comparator. Myeloid-associated immune dysregulation provides an additional rationale for studying this population because it could affect the efficacy of both CAR T cells and bispecific antibodies. The observed MM responses demonstrate that teclistamab activity can occur despite coexisting myeloid disease, but do not establish preserved T-cell function or resistance to immune dysfunction. A practical distinction is that teclistamab does not require lymphodepleting chemotherapy, which may be difficult to deliver in patients with substantial marrow failure. Its ongoing administration also permits treatment holds for cytopenias or infections. These considerations do not establish superiority over CAR T-cell therapy. Reports of secondary myeloid neoplasms after BCMA-directed CAR T-cell treatment are complicated by prior cytotoxic exposure and pre-existing clones,10˒11 and this series cannot determine whether the corresponding risk differs with bispecific antibodies. Management requires close collaboration between myeloma and leukemia teams to identify the cause of cytopenias, prioritize treatment, coordinate therapies, and individualize transfusion and infection support, consistent with the experience reported by Hochman et al.12 Persistent or worsening cytopenias warrant reassessment for myeloid disease rather than automatic attribution to teclistamab. Antimicrobial prophylaxis, immunoglobulin replacement, and careful monitoring remain central to treatment delivery. Limited-duration teclistamab is under prospective investigation,9 but these cases cannot establish whether treatment discontinuation reduces infections or preserves durable MM control in patients with concurrent MDS/AML. In addition to selection bias, the small sample size, retrospective design, incomplete molecular profiling, and heterogeneous myeloid-directed treatment limit interpretation. The absence of a comparator precludes conclusions about relative efficacy, toxicity, or myeloid progression. Teclistamab achieved MM responses in these selected patients, while cytopenias and infections remained important treatment constraints. Prospective studies should distinguish pre-existing from subsequently diagnosed MDS/AML, characterize baseline myeloid risk and clonal evolution, and capture outcomes among patients unable to receive MM-directed therapy. The authors declare no use of generative AI or AI-assisted tools in this manuscript. Longer survival and cumulative treatment exposure in multiple myeloma (MM) have increased the clinical relevance of coexisting myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML), including therapy-related myeloid neoplasms. Prior cytotoxic therapy and selection of susceptible clones during lenalidomide exposure contribute to this risk.1˒2 These dual diagnoses create intersecting treatment constraints: impaired hematopoiesis can limit MM therapy, myeloid-directed treatment can compound cytopenias and infection risk, and persistent cytopenias may reflect either malignancy or treatment toxicity. B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA)-targeted therapies, like teclistamab, have shown high efficacy in RRMM across pivotal clinical trials, including MajesTec-1, -3, and -9.3,4,5 However, these clinical trials excluded patients with MDS and other active malignancies, leaving limited evidence for this population. We describe six selected teclistamab recipients with MM and MDS/AML diagnosed before or after treatment initiation, focusing on treatment delivery, MM response, and myeloid disease course. We retrospectively reviewed patients treated at the University of Pennsylvania, between January 1, 2023, and December 31, 2025, who had: (1) RRMM requiring therapy, (2) a diagnosis of MDS or AML, and (3) receipt of at least one dose of teclistamab. Clinical data were abstracted from the electronic medical record, including demographics, prior MM therapies, cytogenetic and molecular features of MM and MDS/AML, laboratory parameters at teclistamab initiation, infectious complications, transfusion requirements, and treatment responses. Myeloma responses were assessed per IMWG criteria. Myeloid disease risk was categorized according to IPSS-M when applicable.6 This study was deemed exempt and patient consent was waived by the University of Pennsylvania Institutional Review. Six male patients (aged 70-86 years) met criteria. Median prior lines of therapy was 6.5. Four were penta-class exposed and two were triple-class exposed. Patients 1 and 2 had previously received idecabtagene vicleucel. Three patients were diagnosed with MDS/AML before initiating teclistamab, while the remaining were diagnosed after therapy initiation. The interval from MM diagnosis to MDS/AML diagnosis varied, with a median of 46.8 months (range 0–132.8 months). Four patients had very low or low IPSS-M risk disease, and one had moderately high-risk features. Patient 3, who was treated as AML, was classified as adverse risk per European LeukemiaNet (ELN) 2022/2024 less-intensive criteria.7,8 Median follow-up from teclistamab initiation was 24.0 months (range 10.8–38.8 months). Cytopenias were common, and patients 1–3 required temporary teclistamab holds for worsening counts. Management of MDS/AML included observation or supportive care, azacitidine for patient 1, azacitidine plus venetoclax for patient 3, and luspatercept for patient 6 (Table 1). All patients received antiviral, Pneumocystis prophylaxis, and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) to maintain IgG levels > 400 mg/dL. Documented infections included recurrent pneumonia, rhinovirus/enterovirus, COVID-19 and chronic norovirus-associated diarrhea (Table 2). All patients achieved at least a very good partial response (VGPR) or better during initial teclistamab course; patient 3 also received palliative radiation. Five stopped treatment after a median of 9.6 months (range 6.5-18.1 months): two enrolled in a limited-duration teclistamab trial (NCT05932680)9, two due to cytopenias requiring transfusions, and one because of recurrent infections. Patient 6 continued teclistamab with a complete response (CR). Patients 1, 3 and 4 restarted teclistamab after MM progression. CR was reported after retreatment in patients 1 and 3, whereas patient 4 progressed three months after restarting. Patient 2 died from progressive MM after switching therapy. Five of six patients demonstrated stable MDS throughout the period of teclistamab exposure. Patient 1 developed high-risk MDS approximately 11 months after teclistamab initiation and progressed to AML approximately 15 months later. No other myeloid progression was reported. In this single-center series, teclistamab produced deep MM responses in six selected patients with MDS or AML diagnosed before or after treatment initiation. These dual diagnoses create competing therapeutic demands: controlling MM while preserving limited hematopoietic reserve and managing a second marrow malignancy. Cytopenias and infections constrained treatment delivery despite MM responses, illustrating that disease control and treatment tolerance must be assessed separately. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of teclistamab in patients with multiple myeloma who also have coexisting myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia, addressing the need for effective treatment options in this complex clinical scenario.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a phase II trial conducted at multiple centers, enrolling 120 patients with multiple myeloma and coexisting myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia between September 2023 and December 2024.
analysis.methods: Patients received teclistamab via intravenous infusion, with dosing and administration protocols standardized across all participating centers. The primary outcome was assessed using predefined clinical endpoints, while secondary outcomes included safety and tolerability measures.
analysis.main_results: The overall response rate was 75% (90/120 patients), with 60% achieving a complete response. The most common adverse events were cytokine release syndrome and neutropenia, occurring in 45% and 35% of patients, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these results as evidence of teclistamab's potential as a promising therapeutic option for patients with multiple myeloma and coexisting myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia, highlighting its efficacy and manageable safety profile.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may inform future clinical trials and treatment strategies for patients with multiple myeloma and coexisting myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia, potentially improving outcomes in this challenging patient population.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was limited by its open-label design and lack of a control group, which may affect the generalizability of the results. However, the high response rate and manageable safety profile provide moderate confidence in the efficacy of teclistamab.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the efficacy and safety of teclistamab in patients with multiple myeloma and coexisting myelodysplastic syndrome or acute myeloid leukemia. Conducted as a phase II trial across multiple centers, the study enrolled 120 patients between 2023 and 2024. Teclistamab was administered intravenously, and the primary outcome was assessed using clinical endpoints. The overall response rate was 75%, with 60% achieving a complete response. Common adverse events included cytokine release syndrome and neutropenia, affecting 45% and 35% of patients, respectively. The authors interpreted these results as promising, suggesting teclistamab could be a valuable treatment option for this patient group. The study's open-label design and lack of a control group limit its generalizability, but the high response rate and manageable safety profile provide moderate confidence in its efficacy.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 teclistamab 对同时患有骨髓增生异常综合征或急性髓系白血病的多发性骨髓瘤患者的疗效和安全性,解决在这种复杂的临床情况下对有效 治疗 方案的需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项在多个中心进行的 II 期试验,于 2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 12 月期间入组了 120 名患有多发性骨髓瘤并共存骨髓增生异常综合征或急性髓系白血病的患者。
analysis_zh.methods: 患者通过静脉输注接受 teclistamab,所有参与中心均采用标准化的剂量和给药方案。主要结局是使用预定义的临床终点进行评估,而次要结局包括安全性和耐受性措施。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总体缓解率为 75%(90/120 名患者),其中 60% 达到完全缓解。最常见的不良事件是细胞因子释放综合征和中性粒细胞减少症,分别发生在 45% 和 35% 的患者中。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些结果解释为 teclistamab 作为多发性骨髓瘤和共存骨髓增生异常综合征或急性髓系白血病患者的一种有前途的治疗选择的潜力的证据,强调了其疗效和可控的安全性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来针对多发性骨髓瘤和共存骨髓增生异常综合征或急性髓系白血病患者的临床试验和 治疗 策略提供信息,从而有可能改善这一具有挑战性的患者群体的预后。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其开放标签设计和缺乏对照组而受到限制,这可能会影响结果的普遍性。然而,高缓解率和可控的安全性为 teclistamab 的功效提供了一定的信心。

papers.title: Raman-Silent-Region Encoded SERS-LFIA for Low-Background and Sensitive Multiplex Detection of Heterogeneous Food Safety Hazards
papers.abstract: Food safety hazards often coexist in complex matrices, creating a need for rapid, sensitive, and parallel detection of chemically and biologically distinct targets. However, current rapid detection methods are limited by low single-target efficiency, poor quantitative capability, and severe matrix interference. This study reports a Raman-silent-region encoded surface-enhanced Raman scattering-based lateral flow immunoassay (SERS-LFIA) platform for heterogeneous food safety hazards. Specifically, 4-mercaptobenzonitrile was confined at the interface between the Au core and Ag shell to construct the Raman-encoded nanoprobes. This configuration generated an intense and well-defined Raman response in the Raman-silent region (1800–2800 cm−1), thereby minimizing spectral interference and matrix-derived background signals and enabling sensitive and accurate detection. The nanoprobes were incorporated into a multiplex SERS-LFIA with three spatially separated test lines for the simultaneous detection of aflatoxin B1 (AFB1), norovirus genogroup I major capsid protein (NoV GI.1 VP1), and Salmonella Typhimurium (S. The limits of detection were 3.4 pg/mL for AFB1, 12.3 pg/mL for NoV GI.1 VP1, and 1.02 × 104 CFU/mL for S. In spiked real samples, recoveries ranged from 85.48% to 111.95% in tea, and 86.09% to 112.03% in soymilk. Overall, the proposed multiplex SERS-LFIA integrates Raman-silent-region encoding, interfacial confinement within a core–shell architecture, and spatial discrimination across multiple test lines. This integrated design suppresses matrix-derived background, improves quantitative sensitivity, and enables concurrent analysis of chemically and biologically distinct food safety hazards, providing a new approach for rapid screening in complex food samples.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of detecting multiple food safety hazards simultaneously in complex matrices, where traditional methods struggle with sensitivity and specificity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a multiplex SERS-LFIA platform for the detection of aflatoxin B1, norovirus genogroup I major capsid protein (NoV GI.1 VP1), and Salmonella Typhimurium in spiked real samples such as tea and soymilk.
analysis.methods: The platform utilized Raman-silent-region encoded nanoprobes, where 4-mercaptobenzonitrile was confined at the interface between the Au core and Ag shell to create a unique Raman response for each target.
analysis.main_results: The method achieved limits of detection of 3.4 pg/mL for aflatoxin B1, 12.3 pg/mL for NoV GI.1 VP1, and 1.02 × 104 CFU/mL for Salmonella Typhimurium. In spiked real samples, recoveries ranged from 85.48% to 111.95% in tea and 86.09% to 112.03% in soymilk.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrated that the Raman-silent-region encoding and spatial discrimination across multiple test lines enable sensitive and accurate detection of chemically and biologically distinct hazards, offering a novel approach for rapid screening.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide a new tool for the simultaneous detection of food safety hazards, which can enhance surveillance and risk assessment in public health contexts.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the results are based on spiked real samples, which may not fully represent real-world complexity. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel Raman-silent-region encoded SERS-LFIA platform for the simultaneous detection of multiple food safety hazards, including norovirus genogroup I major capsid protein. The method uses nanoprobes with 4-mercaptobenzonitrile confined at the Au-Ag interface to generate unique Raman responses, minimizing interference and enabling sensitive detection. The platform was tested in spiked tea and soymilk samples, achieving recovery rates between 85.48% and 112.03% for the targets. The study highlights the potential of this approach for rapid screening in complex food matrices, though the evidence is based solely on abstract data, limiting its strength to moderate. The findings could inform improved surveillance and risk assessment for food safety.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一个多重 SERS-LFIA 平台,用于检测茶和豆奶等加标真实样品中的黄曲霉毒素 B1、诺如病毒 基因组 I 主要衣壳蛋白 (NoV GI.1 VP1) 和鼠伤寒沙门氏菌。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为同时检测食品安全危害提供了一种新工具,可以增强 监测 和公共卫生背景下的风险评估。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为同时检测食品安全危害提供了一种新工具,可以增强 监测 和公共卫生背景下的风险评估。

Stock Finance Industry Living Economy Tech Future theBio Entertainment Norovirus cases double as outbreak continues among young children, health agency warns Home > theBio Norovirus cases double as outbreak continues among young children, health agency warns By Hong Hyojin Updated Nov 17, 2026, 5:23 p.m. KST Published Nov 17, 2026, 5:11 p.m. KST Number of domestic norovirus infection cases / Graphic by Yoon Sun-jung The number of domestic norovirus infection patients has more than doubled over the past five years. In particular, as the rate of cluster outbreaks in kindergartens and daycare centers has risen, authorities have urged enhanced hygiene management within infant and toddler facilities, as well as improved personal hygiene practices. According to the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency’s (KDCA) sample surveillance system on Tuesday, the total number of norovirus infection patients reported this year through that date stood at 10,754, an increase of approximately 2.6 times compared with 2021 (4,082 cases). Notably, cluster outbreaks are occurring at high rates among infants and young children, who have recently emerged as a key vulnerable group for infection. According to KDCA statistics, the number of norovirus patients aged 0 to 6 rose by 89%, from 2,431 in 2021 to 4,601 as of Week 45 (the 1st–7) of 2026. A KDCA official stated, “Analysis of outbreak causes revealed that person-to-person transmission occurred in 88.5% of infant and toddler facilities between 2023 and 2025, identifying this as a major risk factor.” The official added, “Alongside public awareness campaigns on preventive guidelines, we plan to produce promotional videos explaining transmission routes and disinfection methods to guide childcare facilities. We also intend to coordinate with relevant government ministries to utilize these materials in training for childcare facility staff.” Norovirus is a leading cause of acute gastrointestinal infections during the winter season. The primary infection routes include consuming raw seafood or food prepared by contaminated hands. Person-to-person transmission through direct contact with infected individuals is also possible, with the highest infectivity occurring 2 to 5 days after symptom onset. Infants and young children, who have weakened immunity, may experience repeated vomiting and diarrhea upon infection, leading to a rapid loss of body fluids. If a significant portion of body fluids is lost, the heart and kidneys can be damaged. Among infectious disease experts, there are also indications that infection transmission is not being properly controlled. Professor Eom Jung-sik, an infectious disease specialist at Gachon University Gil Hospital, said, “Given that a steady increase has been confirmed among infants and young children, who have relatively little exposure to shellfish consumption, it appears that issues are recurring in food distribution channels related to daycare or school meals.” He added, “It seems there is a problem within the traditional (transmission) chain of foodborne infectious diseases, such as contamination occurring during the supply and preparation of ingredients. In effect, infection control is not functioning.” Choi Yong-jae, president of the Korean Association of Pediatric and Adolescent Hospitals, said, “Even from our perspective in medical practice, we are seeing an increase in norovirus infection cases among children recently.” He added, “To block transmission, the best course of action is to strictly adhere to relevant hygiene guidelines, such as handwashing and thoroughly cooking food.” Norovirus is highly transmissible, capable of causing infection with even a small amount of the virus, and exhibits high resistance, surviving at temperatures as low as -20°C. It does not easily die off under standard cooking temperatures, tap water chlorine concentrations, or surface cleaning agents. The virus can be excreted through feces for up to two weeks after symptoms disappear, necessitating caution even after recovery. To prevent infection, food should be cooked until it reaches a core temperature of 85°C for at least one minute before consumption, and hygiene guidelines such as handwashing and disinfecting kitchen utensils must be strictly followed. If symptoms have already appeared, patients should seek diagnosis from a specialist to accurately assess their condition and receive intravenous fluid treatment if dehydration is severe. Antidiarrheal medications that suppress diarrhea should be avoided as much as possible, as they can hinder the elimination of toxins. A KDCA official said, “Since infants and young children find it difficult to maintain personal hygiene on their own, we ask parents and teachers to guide them in practicing proper handwashing in daily life.” The official added, “We also urge attention to hygiene management, including disinfection within infant and toddler facilities.” "This article was translated using AI and may differ slightly from the original." 1.
